title: Top of the Tower
prompt:
View from the inside of a luxury, penthouse apartment, looking out to the huge floor to ceiling windows at the night sky, and the incredible city scape - include a variety of buildings, and a river dotted with boats ect.

The inside of the apartment it is cosy and modern. It is dark in the apartment apart from a lamp that lets out a gentle warm glow. The vibe is moody, atmospheric - it's raining hard outside, and you can hear the wind this high up buffeting the tallest building in the city that you're at the top of.

---

Feel free to add/tweak to this - those are my ideas so far. I want something moody, a bit melancholy - kind of like a modern 'lonely king' at the top of the tower feel
description: A dark penthouse at the top of the city's tallest tower looks out through floor-to-ceiling windows at a rain-swept skyline and a river dotted with boats. One floor lamp lights an empty armchair and a side table: a lonely seat at the top of the world.

generate.brief: night city skyline seen from high above: varied towers, office blocks and spires with small yellow windows, a wide dark river winding below with tiny boats, heavy violet storm clouds, soft light rising from the streets below, fills the whole canvas edge to edge
tall slim floor lamp, brass stem, round brass base, cream linen drum shade, front view, cool light from behind
modern armchair, dark charcoal wool, cream throw over one arm, front view, warm light from the left
small round side table, black metal legs, dark marble top, one crystal whisky tumbler on top, front view, warm light from the left
heavy dark velvet curtain hanging in deep folds, deep violet, front view, warm light from the left

music.brief: slow sparse piano over low strings, melancholy and calm
